mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.2% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.2% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate decline below 4.0% signals robust labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive 5-day SPX returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts growth (HOUST > 1200) and retail sales expansion (RSAFS > 470000) indicate strong consumer demand, driving positive 60-day SPX returns via revenue acceleration.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 470000 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 0.5% monthly (INDPRO > 105.0) indicates manufacturing expansion that boosts corporate output and equity valuations, yielding positive 20-day SPX returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 17000) consistently correlates with improved corporate earnings outlook, generating positive 20-day SPX returns through sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 17000 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >50% of cases over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 0.3% monthly (CPIAUCSL > 244.0) triggers Fed rate hike expectations, causing negative SPX returns over 5 trading days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 244.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent employment growth (PAYEMS > 146000) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < 4.3) signal labor market strength that increases disposable income and consumer spending, driving positive 60-day SPX returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS > 146000 and UNRATE < 4.3 fails to yield positive 60-day returns in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Inflationary environment (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY) with stable rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) delays Fed tightening, producing positive SPX returns over 20 days as market anticipates accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS < 1.5%.
